quality.v2_768p: Best output: dense bamboo detail, volumetric sunrise light, clean foreground fur, stable dolly-in.
quality.omniref_480p: Both ordered references preserved (red/green outfits, hair, faces, chin shadow), coherent neon market and rain. Faces are near-identical because the inputs are hue-shifted copies of one portrait.
quality.trim_480p: Realistic wet asphalt, reflections and rain; credible preview. Advantage is 35.4 GB checkpoint / 34.7 GiB peak, not a large 480p denoise speedup.
quality.i2v: First paid run failed on the packed T2V AdaLN table; fixed and unit-tested but not re-rendered within budget.
quality.v2_480p: Strong composition, coherent red panda, convincing fog/light, stable across the clip.

billing_official.note: Final reconciled official metered cost for the whole H3 exercise, including earlier experiments and failed attempts; not a per-clip price. Existing $28 soft budget / $30 credits unchanged.

quality_first_runs.quality: Exact frame 0; face/hair/red palette coherent through 10 s; market/rain stable; wardrobe reinterpreted as hoodie/coat.
Exact frame 0; stable identity through 14.5 s; brief back-view walking shot; red coat/hoodie reinterpretation; no OOM.
Both endpoints exact: red first frame and green last frame; middle keeps red character. Proves FL2VA anchoring.
Red and green characters distinct and consistent through 9.5 s with official subject/<Picture N> prompt. Flat reference style retained; realistic market background.
Red/green distinction restored with explicit prompt; vague prompt run rejected for fidelity.
Red/green characters distinct and consistent through 14.5 s; tightest memory route, ~10.8 GiB headroom.
Enhanced prompt preserved anime/cutout style, character, red outfit and neon market. Earlier enhancement over-invented a photoreal interior and was rejected.
Exact portrait first frame, no forced 16:9 crop; anime/cutout style and red coat preserved through 4.8 s; H.264 stream-copied by FFmpeg.

rejected_quality_runs.reason: Vague "both characters" prompt collapsed both references to red and added an unrequested man; rejected for reference fidelity.

checkpoint_decision.original_minimax_h3: 33B dense transformer, full attention only; official sparse attention not in initial release; ~144 GB FL2VA stack and 50-step examples; not practical at 768p 10-15 s on one 96 GB GPU. Experimental/non-public worker profile only.
checkpoint_decision.fasth3_v2_qad: Default. NVFP4/VSA 8-forward student; FL2VA pipeline accepts first/last images and was validated at 768p 5/10/15 s with full VAE.
checkpoint_decision.fasth3_omniref: Reference route. Full VAE; 10 s/768p retains distinct red/green references with explicit subject prompts. Vague prompts can collapse references.
checkpoint_decision.fasth3_trim: Hidden preview; not a quality route.
checkpoint_decision.prompt_enhancement: OpenAI-compatible enhancer implemented and live-tested against OpenCode Go (https://opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1, deepseek-v4.1-flash, x-opencode-session). It produced a structured H3 prompt; it falls back to the original prompt on errors.

prompt_enhancement_live.status: success with official guides and image input
prompt_enhancement_live.note: I2VA, FL2VA and Ref2VA previews returned the official instruction/six-section structures; images were analyzed by deepseek-v4.1-flash.
prompt_enhancement_live.quality: Preserved anime/cutout character, red outfit and neon market; first version was rejected for photoreal restyling.
